Q2 yes: Revelio Labs says 454 employees as of March 2026. ZoomInfo and LeadIQ give 201-500 (LeadIQ lists 378 people), and the enrichment says 372. All of these are inside the 100-1000 band. Q3 no: web_fetch loaded the signal page. It names Fetch Package and shows one Warehouse Supervisor job in Atlanta, posted Oct 6, 2026, which is inside the window. But the rubric only counts a job post if it is on the company's own site or names at least 2 roles. This page is on the Capital Factory/Getro portfolio job board, not fetchpackage.com, and it lists a single role, so it fails the job-post rule. A single hourly supervisor opening is also not a hiring wave. Small mismatch: the live page shows USD 21.65/hour, but the evidence excerpt says 21.85. This does not change the verdict.
